feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 October 2026 11:54am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 14 October 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Rapidly deepening area of low pressure approaching Iceland as a ridge of high pressure covers much of the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 6 or 7, occasionally touching gale 8 this afternoon and evening. Decreasing 4 to 6 through the morning tomorrow, then veering west or northwest towards midday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough becoming mainly moderate tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain arriving from the west early tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5 soon decreasing 3 or 4 Thursday afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 again in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate soon becoming slight or moderate, then slight later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, heavy at times, gradually clearing towards the southeast Thursday afternoon or evening. Fair later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in heavy rain, becoming good later.
